description: This Java source file defines the GatewayResponse class, which models the response from a payment gateway (eWay). It includes methods for parsing XML responses, accessing response fields, and handling payment transaction data.

classes.name: GatewayResponse
classes.description: Represents the response from the eWay payment gateway, capable of parsing XML responses and providing access to transaction details.

methods.name: getTrxnNumber
methods.description: Returns the transaction number from the response.

methods.name: getReturnAmount
methods.description: Returns the return amount as an integer.

methods.name: getTransactionAmount
methods.description: Returns the transaction amount as a BigDecimal scaled to 2 decimal places.

methods.name: getTrxnStatus
methods.description: Returns the transaction status as a boolean.

methods.name: getBeagleScore
methods.description: Returns the Beagle score, or -1 if not available.

methods.name: GatewayResponse
methods.description: Constructor that parses an XML InputStream to populate response fields.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the response in XML format.
